scope: Local Release verification of the AgentModelGateway extraction
verified_paths: The real AgentRunner provider/tool loop uses an injected AgentModelGateway.
Responses context counting and compaction use the gateway in the context-engine contract.
The production local adapter resolves credential bytes internally and accepts no secret in the call values.
limitations: This does not implement a worker or IPC gateway adapter.
Workspace, edit approvals, process, MCP, A2A and other effect services remain in-process backend dependencies.
This selected contract set is not a full 147-test Release rerun or packaged runtime acceptance.
